description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeMembershipService class, which provides business logic for managing employee memberships within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations and search functionality related to employee memberships.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipService
classes.description: Provides methods for managing employee memberships, including CRUD and search operations within the HRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeMembershipDao instance.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeMembership entity using the DAO.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeMembership by employee number and membership ID.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Searches for employee memberships based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee memberships matching search filters.
